purpose: Discriminate observed original/native guest-relative vs absolute-host result onset in three independent genuine archived 2014 events; not a gameplay equivalence adjudication.

entries.name: Zoom Zoo
entries.evidence_limitation: Guest-state transition native one relative frame ahead; original/native result onset NOT equal on host timeline; a transient saved-contact difference later converges. No workaround by shifting input.

entries.name: Bowl
entries.evidence_limitation: Both scored result/tally host frames match; tally full-guest WRAM/VRAM scratch differences exist. Does not establish guest PC/NMI or all gameplay frame parity.

entries.name: Switcher
entries.evidence_limitation: Original/native track/menu handoff differs at guest-relative +4664/+4697/+4698, with other captured semantic fields equal. Original return +4699..+4701 was not yet sampled; strict guest-relative result fails.

cross_event_observation: In all 3 events native enters 1-2 absolute host frames later and reports terminal 1-2 guest-relative frames earlier. The DIFFERENT absolute host outcomes (Zoo +1, Bowl 0, Switcher 0) show this is not a single universally corrected input shift or proof of common execution cause.
